a:t.name: guidance
a:t.value: Do not vaccinate client with inactivated hepatitis A vaccination if client has had a severe allergic reaction to the previous dose. Do not vaccinate client with live attenuated hepatitis A vaccination if client has severe allergy to components included in the live attenuated hepatitis A-containing vaccines.
